messages:
Mia Connors: Quick sync — Datadog engineering just flagged an issue for the marketplace tile: they want OTLP payloads to include a stable metric prefix (redwood.marketplace.*) so their dashboards can be generic across partners. They asked if we can add a prefixing layer in the OTLP exporter or via a lightweight mux in the collector.

Sanjeev Patel: We can do prefixing either at the exporter or at the collector as a pipeline processor. Collector approach is less invasive for customers.

Anna Ramirez: Is there a perf/regression cost to doing prefixing in collector? partner SI will want a clear statement.

Sanjeev Patel: negligible if we use the attributes processor with a static attribute and a rename. The main hitch: traces vs metrics naming. Traces use resource attributes, metrics use metric names.

DD Eng Liaison: @Mia Connors thanks for the heads up. Datadog prefers collector-side so the tile can be a drop-in config. We also want a documented mapping so users can filter by `redwood.marketplace.*` in the dashboards.

Jordan T.: Proposed plan: ship a sample otel-collector config for the marketplace tile that does: 1) attach resource.attr marketplace_name, 2) rename metrics to add prefix, 3) add a metadata tag `marketplace_tile:datadog`. Can stub a dashboard JSON with filters for that tag.

Mia Connors: Sounds good. Can we include a fallback: if a customer already has prefixed metrics, avoid double-prefixing. Also need an upgrade note for customers using older collectors.

Sanjeev Patel: We can do a conditional processor using `match` on metric names. Pseudoconfig below:

```
processors:
  prefixer:
    actions:
      - match: "^((?!redwood.marketplace).)*$"
        rename: "redwood.marketplace.${_name}"
```

This is pseudo-y; will produce actual collector `metrics` processor snippet.

Anna Ramirez: Who owns the dashboard tiles? Product wants to include an explainer in the marketplace listing and an ops-runbook for SI installs.

DD Eng Liaison: Datadog can maintain the preview dashboard JSON. We need to deliver: collector config, a README with expected attribute keys, and a sample query list (e.g., `sum:rate(redwood.marketplace.request.latency{marketplace_tile:datadog}) by {service}`).

Mia Connors: OK owners: Eng (Sanjeev) for config + test harness; Product (Anna) for docs & listing copy; Partnership (me) for coordination with Datadog and SI. Deadline: draft artifacts by EOD next Wednesday (1739040000).

ops-bot: Reminder set for 2024-06-12 09:00 UTC — follow up: marketplace otel prefix PR review. :bell:

Jordan T.: I'll stub the smoke test that sends mixed metric names (prefixed and unprefixed) and verifies dedup + no double-prefix. Will push to the `partners/otel-mux` branch.

Sanjeev Patel: I'll draft the actual collector `metricstransform` config and a Docker smoketest image. Quick test checklist:
- verify prefixed metrics appear once
- verify existing prefixed metrics unchanged
- verify resource attr `marketplace_tile` is set

Anna Ramirez: Great. Also add a note about RBAC in the marketplace tile docs: customers running Dedicated/Private may need different exporter endpoints.

DD Eng Liaison: We'll coordinate the tile review cycle once you have the config + sample dashboard. Datadog legal asked for no brand claims in the tile copy — keep it technical.

Mia Connors: Thanks all. I'll sync with the SI lead (cc @sarah-si) and schedule a 30-min dry-run once artifacts present.
